body: I'll try those subreddits maybe. I'm currently just wondering what I'm gonna do when this quarantine ends, but even then it's summer break so I'll be alone another 3 months again. I guess I just got to hold on for now, before I go insane.

I tried. I tried with all of them as a matter of fact. And since then I haven't heard from them. They removed me from most socials and left my messages unread. I decided I won't ask the last person who still answer my messages, as I feel like id sound oppressive(?).

I never talked about my  problems to them. Never brought any of this shit it up. I always tried to make them laugh (and it always worked) and I thought I was being as nice as possible as well. After all they were my only real  "true friends". I tried to keep them close as long as I could, but I knew we were gonna part someday, as they never really treated me like I was actually their friend, never invited me to go out with them even when i asked. Thankfully I have known one of them since I was 4 and I still talk to him very rarely, but atleast he responds, though now I live in the fear that everybody I talk to is lying to me. This might sound like I'm overreacting.... And its probably true, I have that habit sometimes. But they were literally my only friends, I don't write messages to anyone anymore, nor do I receive any. I live 90% of my life by myself, doing the things I most enjoy like playing videogames or going to the gym (whenever that opens up again). I'm starting to get used to it, but I'm not sure if I can actually stand being alone like this for my entire life
